message: Scaled 3 of 5 feed rates to 80 %; 2 left as the possible lead of a tapping cycle. No machine: profile defaults assumed.

findings.message: F500 is the feed in force when CYCLE840 runs on line 6. A tapping cycle written as a call can take its thread lead from that feed (the feed is then the spindle speed times the pitch), so it is left as written: scaled, it would cut a different thread. Scale it by hand if the cycle takes its lead from its own arguments.

F520 is written while CYCLE840 (line 6) repeats after every move. A tapping cycle written as a call can take its thread lead from that feed (the feed is then the spindle speed times the pitch), so it is left as written: scaled, it would cut a different thread. Scale it by hand if the cycle takes its lead from its own arguments.
